description: Chef guard: before a build, test or install command, ask the user to confirm when the machine is busy (low RAM, high CPU, fullscreen app or game, microphone in use).

hooks.command: command -v powershell.exe >/dev/null || exit 0; input=$(cat); pattern=$(tr -d '\r' < "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/heavy-commands.regex"); printf '%s' "$input" | grep -qiE "$pattern" || exit 0; ROOT=$(printf %s "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" | sed 's|^/\([a-zA-Z]\)/|\1:/|'); printf '%s' "$input" | powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "$ROOT/hooks/guard.ps1"
